description_en: Queries available HPC clusters. The request parameters are used as filters. The filters are evaluated by using a logical AND. The parameters are independent of each other
description_zh: 调用 DescribeHpcClusters 查询您可用的HPC集群。请求参数作为筛选器（Filter）使用，筛选关系为逻辑与关系，参数之间无依赖关系
name: DescribeHpcClusters

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of HPC clusters. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 HPC cluster IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
HPC集群ID。
取值可以由多个HPC集群ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: hpc_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the HPC cluster list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
HPC集群列表的页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the HPC cluster list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 输入时设置的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of HPC clusters
